(define (count-digit n)
  (let loop ([n n] [d 1])
    (if (< n 10)
        d
        (loop (quotient n 10) (add1 d)))))

(define (first-digit n)
  (quotient n (e (- (count-digit n) 1))))

(define (combine x y)
  (+ (* x (e (count-digit y)))
     y))

               (> (combine x y) (combine y x))))))
